name: Criticals on ability checks
author: Alexandria
summary: A natural 20 on a check is the best outcome the task allows; a natural 1 is a setback, not an automatic failure.

rules.text: On an ability check, a **natural 20** gives the best result the task can give and something extra if it fits. A **natural 1** brings a complication or setback, even if the total succeeds. Neither makes the impossible possible.

assistant.gm: On an ability check a natural 20 is the best result the task allows plus a small extra; a natural 1 adds a complication even if the total passes. Suggest one short complication or bonus that fits the scene, never an automatic success at the impossible.
assistant.player: At this table a natural 20 on a check gives the best result the task allows, and a natural 1 brings a complication even if you pass. It never makes the impossible possible.
